''See also: [[Silver Light Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|The [[Silver]] [[Light]] is a mental power and artifact that enhances an individual's intellect, allowing them to perceive minute details and reconstruct truths. In [[Elysian]] lore, it is regarded as a gift of wisdom for those with exceptional insight; however, the user [[Alin]] experiences it more as an internal voice characterized by guilt and accusation. Visually, when utilized, the power manifests as shimmering metallic particles that can make a human body appear translucent, revealing internal structures like bones, nerves, and marrow. [[Alin]] can direct this energy in broad sweeps to scan environments for specific sensations like pain or panic, though it is most precise when focused on a single target. The [[Silver]] [[Light]] possesses its own consciousness, communicating through whispers and mental presence to offer commentary or observations regarding [[Alin]]'s motivations and surroundings. It is understood to be a [[Silver artifact]] that, when paired with [[Red Light]], serves to augment the mind.}}

== City of Light ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|In [[Elysian]] legend and tradition, the [[Silver]] [[Light]] is a power of wisdom that allows a user to see through skin and into the marrow of a human body. [[Alin]] possesses this power, which he can call upon to search the city or command to spread throughout its streets. While it can function as a screen or provide protection through a bond, the [[Silver]] [[Light]] is also a whispering voice that radiates sadness. During his journey, the entity warned [[Alin]] of people scrambling from the [[Naraka Gate]] and alerted him to something below. Finally, the [[Silver]] [[Light]] pointed out that killing [[Zakareth]] did not mean things were good.}}
